Hi Sergio,

We're finalizing legal review for the Redwood DPA and need a couple of items to close our checklist before procurement will issue an SOW:

- Full subprocessor roster (names, high-level role, country of processing) that will touch BlueWave data for hosted inference and telemetry.
- KMS/HSM jurisdiction matrix (where keys are held, whether HSM-backed, and whether keys/metadata transit outside EU).
- Snapshot evidence for SOC 2 and any recent audit artifacts you can share (redacted is fine).

Can you provide a single package or links we can review? If possible we'd like the roster and KMS matrix by EOD your time tomorrow so our legal team can complete a short assessment.

Also flag if there are any planned subprocessor changes in the next 30 days that could affect residency or egress paths.

Thanks — Elena

Hi team — pulling together the technical details. Summary below and I'm attaching the files referenced.

Summary (short):
- Subprocessors touching customer inference data:
  1) EdgeCache Ltd. — telemetry/cache layer — processing in EU (IE), US (us-west1) for burst routing.
  2) TelemetryStream Inc. — observability/metrics (EU primary, US backup).
  3) KMS CloudOps (managed KMS) — key storage in us-west1 (primary) and eu-west1 (replica). HSM-backed keys for EU tenant isolation are provisioned in eu-west1 on request.
  4) ModelMirror Partners — model artifact distribution (storage in US, artifacts pulled to regional nodes).

- KMS/HSM notes:
  - BlueWave tenant keys are by default stored in us-west1 (KMS CloudOps). We can provision HSM-backed key stores in eu-west1 scoped to BlueWave to meet onshore requirements; this requires a short config change and a commitment to export controls (no automatic cross-border replication for those keys).
  - Metadata and metrics may transit the US for analytics unless eu-only routing is requested (we have a routing flag to keep telemetry/eval logs within EU).

- Planned changes: none scheduled in the next 30 days that affect residency. We do have a minor provider update for ModelMirror Partners in approx. 45 days (no change to key custody).

Attached evidence in the Drive bundle and included files: subprocessor_roster_v1.csv, kms_jurisdiction_matrix.pdf, soc2_snapshot-2027-03.pdf, escrow_attestation.zip. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3k-SubprocEvidence.

Jira ticket for tracking: INF-5721 (internal: KMS jurisdiction confirmation for BlueWave).

If you'd like the HSM-only provisioning step documented as an addendum to the DPA we can include a short Appendix A with the configuration steps and change window.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
